import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.PrintStream;

class Solution {

	public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
		solve(System.in, System.out);
	}

	static void solve(InputStream input, PrintStream output) throws IOException {
		BufferedInputStream in = new BufferedInputStream(input);
		int count = (int) nextNumber(in);
		long highest = nextNumber(in);
		long loss = 0;
		for (int i = 1; i < count; i++) {
			long value = nextNumber(in);
			loss = Math.min(loss, value - highest);
			highest = Math.max(highest, value);
		}
		output.println(loss);
	}

	private static long nextNumber(InputStream in) throws IOException {
		int c;
		do {
			c = in.read();
			if (c == -1)
				throw new IOException("Unexpected end of input");
		} while (c <= ' ');
		long value = 0;
		while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
			value = value * 10 + c - '0';
			c = in.read();
		}
		return value;
	}
}
